item.title: A media-rich walkthrough of the verified change
item.dc:creator: Research Author
item.description: The media walkthrough explains the rule, the deadline, and concrete implementation steps that teams can follow. It includes a hosted audio episode and a cover image with additional context for planning adoption across the next quarter and beyond for operators.
